items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: So Colonel Hicks, he said, why don't you organize? He said, will you give me the privilege? I said, sure.

ctx.x: How did that Goodwill Society work? Actually, I don't know anything about that anymore.

Well, I had the privilege, being a foeman, of going into the higher up of the brackets, meeting the colonels. And then too, I played a little music then, and I would meet these colonels at the officers' club, and they'd invite me to the table to take a drink with them. And in so drinking, or talking with them, I would tell them the situation that was on the base. So they'd say, well okay, we're having fun tonight. See me Monday morning. Monday morning, I would be in his office, and I would explain to him the…
Yeah, you left the Civil Service again.
